{{Top}}
[[File:SulfuricAsteroidNaboo.jpg|250px|thumb|A sulfuric asteroid located in the Naboo system]]
'''Sulfur''', or '''sulphur''', was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] element found in natural settings. It could be rafted in molten form on the planet of [[Oko E]]. It was also found in pools on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and in geyser fields on [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The air of [[Charbi]], [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] smelled of sulfur. As a solid, it formed as yellow blocks.

{{Substance-stub}}
